CDS Protocol J - Joint Support

Protocol cds protocol joint arthritis

Evidence: Grade C (scientific)

Summary

Joint support protocol using anti-inflammatory and supportive dosing for musculoskeletal conditions.

Indications

  • Joint pain
  • Arthritis
  • Joint inflammation
  • Musculoskeletal support

Steps

  1. Prepare joint support dose
  2. Combine CDS with supportive herbs if appropriate
  3. Follow support schedule
  4. Monitor joint symptoms
  5. Track mobility

Dosage

Joint support protocol: 1 ml CDS in 100ml water, 2 times daily

Expected Outcomes

  • Joint pain reduction
  • Inflammation reduction
  • Improved mobility
  • Joint support

Monitoring

  • Monitor joint pain
  • Track mobility
  • Watch for inflammatory response
  • Adjust as needed

Frequency: 2 times daily
